name: origin-aware-saved-workload-gpu-schedule-microbenchmark-v1
scope: baseline-conditioned action-head schedule replay; no environment or VLM inference
condition_order: deterministic balanced cyclic complete blocks with alternating direction

timer.start: after workload tensors are resident on GPU and immediately after torch.cuda.synchronize
timer.stop: after predict_action returns and torch.cuda.synchronize completes

cold_replay.policy: run production cold initialization for cost, then replace its value with the captured selected initial state
cold_replay.reason: preserve the captured cold trajectory while retaining equal production initialization cost in every arm

aggregation.across_tasks: equal-weight macro mean over the fixed ten tasks

bootstrap.resampling: paired episodes within each fixed task
bootstrap.simultaneous_method: centered max downward error across the frozen six candidates

promotion.interpretation: Only candidates passing the measured simultaneous bound may enter online screening; this benchmark does not establish closed-loop performance.
